gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-th: Bowls that nearly seal shut give Jelly Crazies a wobbly, playful look without any calligraphic thinning. But Noto Sans Thai Looped speeds a full page back up, its tall bodies and spacious curve endings reading bold.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-ti: Noto Sans Tifinagh is round, open and inviting, its lowercase bowls inflated. Under Jelly Crazies, whose monoweight stroke wobbles playfully, that sans-serif body gives the page somewhere open to rest.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-vi: Wobbly, playful Jelly Crazies sits up top with its bowls nearly shut. Noto Sans Vithkuqi has open throats and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, so it can shrink without clogging.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-wa: Bent-tubing letters, same gauge throughout: that is Jelly Crazies in a line. Noto Sans Warang Citi, a contemporary sans-serif, makes words read as solid blocks, and that steadiness is the real strength here.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-za: Wobbly and playful, Jelly Crazies closes its bowls nearly shut while Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars on a tall x-height. One makes a stir; the other keeps tiny sizes crisp.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-onest: Onest keeps its ascenders short above big bowls and draws a gentle, steady line, never pooling ink where curves turn in. Shrink Jelly Crazies small and its wobbly bowls would clot.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-orienta: Orienta opens its counters like a hollow reed cut open, with little height difference between upper and lower case. Whole paragraphs of it would glide, even after Jelly Crazies.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-oxygen: Wobbly and playful, with bowls nearly sealed shut: that is Jelly Crazies. Oxygen, a contemporary sans-serif whose curves never close back on themselves and whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, loosens everything up below.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-puritan: Playful Jelly Crazies wobbles on nearly shut bowls, while Puritan keeps its rounded forms clearly open to the side. Jelly Crazies loves a splash, while Puritan loves oversized, open counters.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-questrial: Playful Jelly Crazies wobbles through nearly shut bowls, while Questrial draws open, single-weight shapes with a flat, stencil-cut feel. Loose and wobbly meets flat and crisp, so each makes the other louder.
